core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
rationale: All members regulate (mostly inhibit) Ca2+, Na+ or K+ movement across the plasma membrane, whereas confusables centre on muscle action potentials, cardiac repolarization or two-pore K+ channels and lack the sodium-transport members.

name: Semaphorin-plexin signaling via Sema3A and Sema4D
rationale: All members are semaphorin-plexin pathways (Sema3A repulsion, Sema4D growth-cone collapse, RND1, CRMPs), distinguishing them from confusables built on general axon guidance, netrin, ephrin or Rho-GPCR signaling.

name: Transcriptional response to UV radiation
rationale: All members are UV-B or UV-induced/repressed gene responses, while confusables concern UV-damage excision repair, NF-kB stress responses or oxidative stress.

qualifier: AMPA receptor endosomal recycling and clustering
name: AMPA receptor trafficking and clustering at excitatory synapses
rationale: Members cover AMPA/glutamate receptor endosomal transport, internalization, clustering and diffusion trapping with their plasticity outputs, whereas confusables emphasise NMDA/kainate receptor activation, LTP or synaptic depression.

name: Endocannabinoid synthesis, degradation and retrograde synaptic signaling
rationale: All members concern DAG/MAG and N-acylethanolamine lipid turnover and endocannabinoid retrograde signaling, unlike confusables centred on eicosanoids, prostanoids, leukotrienes and resolvins.

core: Inflammatory chemokine production and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion
qualifier: regulation of extravasation and myeloid proinflammatory output
name: Regulation of inflammatory chemokine production and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion
rationale: Members combine myeloid proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine modules with regulation of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 production and leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, whereas confusables emphasise monocyte activation and chemotaxis or lymphocyte TNF/IL-23 activation.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host cells
name: Viral replication and gene expression, including retroviral integration
rationale: All members describe viral genome replication, transcription, translation or their host restriction across HIV, coronaviruses, influenza, RSV and HCMV, and the theme uniquely adds HIV reverse transcription, integration and latency that confusables lack.

name: Control of APC/C-Cdc20 degradation of securin and cyclin B
rationale: Members are APC/C-Cdc20 destruction of securin and cyclin B plus direct APC/C inhibition, distinct from confusables on APC/C-Cdh1, cyclin A, Nek2A, Emi1 or APC/C phosphorylation.

name: Fas (CD95) death receptor apoptosis and its restraint
rationale: Members cover FasL signaling, BID activation and inhibition of Fas/death-receptor apoptosis in hepatocytes and T cells, while confusables centre on TRAIL, caspase-8/c-FLIP or T cell activation signatures.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
name: Myeloid dendritic cell activation and CD4 T cell stimulation
rationale: All members describe activation at the dendritic cell-CD4 T cell interface (DC activation, MHC contact, CD4 proliferation), whereas confusables emphasise negative regulation, Treg differentiation or surface signatures.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members combine carnitine transport/shuttle and beta-oxidation regulation with ketone body synthesis and utilization; confusables have the beta-oxidation steps without ketogenesis or without the carnitine members.

name: DNA replication initiation control and replication-stress checkpoint
rationale: Members regulate replication initiation and progression and its ATR/intra-S checkpoint, distinct from confusables built on E2F/G1-S transcription, pre-RC assembly or G2/M progression.

qualifier: dense-core vesicle release and GPCR activation
name: Neuropeptide dense-core vesicle release and GPCR signaling
rationale: All members describe neuropeptide release and G protein-coupled (including opioid) receptor signaling, whereas confusables concern stress, addiction or sleep behaviours.

qualifier: p53 target-gene transcription and PUMA, including negative regulation
name: p53 transcriptional control of DNA damage-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members are TP53-driven transcription of apoptotic genes, PUMA activation and regulation (including inhibition) of p53/DNA damage intrinsic apoptosis, while confusables hold positive regulation terms, TP53 regulation itself or NOXA/BH3 events.

name: Non-canonical caspase-4/5 inflammasome assembly and substrate cleavage
rationale: All members concern CASP4 and CASP5 inflammasome assembly and cleavage activity, distinct from confusables on NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2/IPAF inflammasomes, pyroptosis or IL-1/IL-18.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translational control
name: RNA-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are AU-rich/3'-UTR binding proteins (TTP, HuR, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, IGF2BPs), decapping and decay, and translational silencing, whereas confusables emphasise deadenylation, splicing/export, polyadenylation or stress granules.

name: tRNA processing, aminoacylation and decoding fidelity
rationale: All members concern tRNA processing, modification, charging (including selenocysteine) and translational fidelity/readthrough, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial gene expression, rRNA modification or translation-factor modification.

name: Positive regulation of leading-edge protrusion formation
rationale: Members promote lamellipodia, pseudopodia and protein localization to the leading edge, while confusables involve negative regulation, Rho GTPase cycles or actin severing/capping.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, direct ossification, trabecular and cranial suture formation, whereas confusables centre on RUNX2, cartilage/joints, mesenchymal stem cells or Wnt.

qualifier: with glycine cleavage and lysine catabolism
name: Lipoate-dependent 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage complexes
rationale: Members share lipoylated, DLD-containing multienzyme complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) and protein lipoylation, distinguishing them from confusables on BCKDH, CoA synthesis, GABA or TCA cycle.

name: Glycine, threonine, alanine and creatine metabolism with gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycine/glyoxylate, threonine, alanine and creatine metabolism plus oxaloacetate/gluconeogenesis, while confusables centre on glutamate/aspartate, conjugation or choline/carnitine.

core: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development
qualifier: RET/GDNF and endothelin signaling, catecholamine synthesis
name: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development with catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members combine RET/GDNF and endothelin signaling in neural crest-derived sympathetic, adrenal and enteric lineages with catecholamine biosynthesis, whereas confusables concern gut motility and blood pressure.

name: NOD-like receptor sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: Members are NOD1/NOD2 and NLR responses to peptidoglycan and bacteria with antibacterial and microbiota effects, distinct from confusables on TLR/LPS signaling, NF-kB machinery or pyroptotic inflammasomes.

name: Trans-Golgi network vesicle biogenesis and lysosomal sorting
rationale: All members concern TGN-derived vesicle formation, retrograde TGN transport and protein targeting to lysosomes, whereas confusables cover endosome-to-Golgi, intra-Golgi traffic or lysosome-related organelles.

name: CD4 T cell differentiation toward Treg and Th1 fates
rationale: Members promote Treg (FOXP3/RUNX1) and Th1 differentiation and restrain Th17 commitment, while confusables concern T cell suppression, AICD or Th1 effector cytokines.
